description:
Looking for a never give up synonym? Here are 20 other ways to say never give up, from "hang in there" to "persevere", plus the one word on many synonym lists that is actually an insult.
Never give up synonyms with examples: https://anotherwordfor.net/never-give-up-synonym/

Part one: what you say to a friend who wants to quit. Part two: phrases for after a setback. Part three: more formal words for work, essays and job applications. Part four: praise or insult? Determined, stubborn and obstinate are not the same. Every phrase comes with a meaning and an example, every part has a quiz, and you practise saying the phrases out loud.

Video credit: clips from One Week (1920), public domain, sound removed.
